CONTENT
COMMENTS
BEST
MINE
NOTES
Read a description of a situation. Then write an e-mail about the situation. You will have 9 minutes. You should aim to write at 50-120 words. Write using complete sentences.
ITEM TEXT
Your
friend
Jim
is
moving
furniture
this
weekend
.
He
originally
asked
you
to
help
,
but
now
your
boss
has
asked
you
to
work
overtime
to
complete
a
task
.
So
you're
writing
an
email
to
explain
why
you
can't
help
.
You
should
write
between
80
and
120
words
.
You
should
include
the
following
reasons
:
Express
gratitude
for
the
invitation
to
help
;
Apologize
for
not
being
able
to
assist
;
Provide
reasons
such
as
work
commitments
,
transportation
limitations
,
and
family
responsibilities
;
Offer
alternative
ways
to
help
or
support
,
if
possible
.
